(b) The editor never calls PATCH /agent-studio/cards (AGENT_EDIT, authz.py:302); its autosave carries the whole card inside PATCH /prompt-versions (BOT_WRITE, authz.py:289) — lazy.tsx:654 `agentCard: asCard(effectiveCard) ?? undefined` → toPatchInput prompt-studio.ts:115 → patch_prompt_version writes agent_card at db_prompt_studio.py:1774-1778 — so tools, skills, connectors and policy bindings are editable with BOT_WRITE alone. Reachable operator action: an admin grants a role BOT_WRITE without AGENT_PUBLISH/AGENT_EDIT through PATCH /roles/{role_id}/permissions (main.py:2995-3000 → db.replace_role_permissions); that user opens the History drawer and clicks 'Rollback to <version>' (VersionHistory.tsx:180-188 → lazy.tsx:992-1024) and production swaps, and toggles a tool on the Tools tab to have the card autosaved. ROLE_DEFAULTS (authz.py:151-203) grant BOT_WRITE only to admin, so it is latent until a role is configured — but the catalogue text at authz.py:131 ('Author and publish prompts, flows and deployments') already asserts the wrong contract.

The load-bearing half of the mechanism is REFUTED by a guard the auditor explicitly said does not exist. backend/alembic/versions/20260725_0039_bot_deployments_active_unique.py creates `uq_bot_deployments_bot_env_active` — a UNIQUE INDEX ON bot_deployments (bot_id, environment) WHERE status = 'active'. So 'two active production rows, hidden by the LIMIT 1 in _ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT_SELECT' cannot happen: rollback_experiment's `UPDATE bot_deployments SET status='active' WHERE id = :baseline` (canary.py:171-174) collides with the row rollback_bot_deployment inserted (db_prompt_studio.py:2377-2404) and raises an IntegrityError, which unwinds the whole `engine.begin()` block and is swallowed by sweep_rollbacks' outer `except Exception` (canary.py:420-422) — the sweep aborts for that pass and every later pass, since the experiment stays 'running'. The auditor's stated fix ('add a partial unique index') is already shipped. What IS real at the cited lines: rollback_bot_deployment (db_prompt_studio.py:2292-2430) never touches deployment_experiments — contrast record_experiment, which promotes running rows first (canary.py:96-106) — and never calls compile_card/assert_publishable or sync_attachments_from_card (contrast db_prompt_studio.py:1905-1927, 1960-1964). Residual real defect: an orphaned 'running' experiment whose canary deployment is already rolled_back, which poisons the auto-rollback sweep, plus a gate-free production re-publish. Severity stays MINOR but the mechanism text must be corrected before it reaches engineering.

Verified by absence: no beforeunload, pagehide, onbeforeunload or useBlocker anywhere in prompt-studio.lazy.tsx (grep over the file returns nothing). The autosave effect's cleanup clears the 1200 ms timer (lazy.tsx:681-683), so an edit made inside the debounce window is dropped on unmount.
